meta.name: caveman-help
meta.description: Quick-reference card for all caveman modes, skills, and commands. One-shot display, not a persistent mode. Trigger: /caveman-help, "caveman help", "what caveman commands", "how do I use caveman".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 速查全部模式、技能与命令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常记不住可用命令或想了解全部功能
copy.tagline_en: Look up all modes, skills, and commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often forget the available commands or want to see all features

howto.what: 当触发时,Claude 会用 caveman 风格显示一张速查卡,列出所有 caveman 模式(如 Lite、Full、Ultra、文言文)、技能(如 caveman-commit、caveman-review)和命令;只显示一次,不切换模式、不保存任何状态。
howto.when: 当你输入 `/caveman-help` 或说出“caveman help”、“what caveman commands”等关键词时触发。

say.note: 显示所有 caveman 模式和技能的速查卡。
询问可用的 caveman 命令。
获取 caveman 的使用说明。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude displays a quick-reference card in caveman style, listing all caveman modes (e.g., Lite, Full, Ultra, Wenyan), skills (e.g., caveman-commit, caveman-review), and commands. It shows once without changing mode or persisting anything.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you enter `/caveman-help` or say phrases like "caveman help", "what caveman commands", etc.

say_en.note: Shows the quick-reference card for all caveman modes and skills.
Gets a quick guide on using caveman.
